title: The Eurozone Dilemma: Sovereignty vs. Integration
grammar: Maastricht Convergence Criteria and Optimal Currency Area Theory
goal: I can analyze the Maastricht convergence criteria (*maastrichti kritériumok, konvergenciaprogram, ERM-II*).

I can synthesize the macro-debate between monetary sovereignty and Eurozone adoption in academic Hungarian.
